templates.source: Official Zmodo Knowledge Base article 'How to Setup Zmodo IP Cameras to Record on Motion Detection without an NVR' (kb.zmodo.com/index.php?solution_id=1306, PDF kb.zmodo.com/pdf.php?artlang=en&cat=156&id=306): 'The RTSP address of the main stream (720p) is: rtsp://xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx:10554/tcp/av0_0'. Applies to Zmodo/Funlux Wi-Fi IP cameras (ZH-series). Confirmed by StrixCamDB lead '/tcp/av0_0'.

Official Zmodo Knowledge Base article 'How to Setup Zmodo IP Cameras to Record on Motion Detection without an NVR' (kb.zmodo.com/index.php?solution_id=1306): 'The RTSP address of the sub stream (VGA) is: rtsp://xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx:10554/tcp/av0_1'. Confirmed by StrixCamDB lead '/tcp/av0_1'.

unverified_leads.note: UDP transport variant of the documented /tcp/av0_0 main stream; the official Zmodo KB prints the /tcp/ form only. Not separately published — treat /tcp/ as canonical.
UDP transport variant of the documented /tcp/av0_1 sub stream; official KB prints /tcp/ only.
double-slash duplicate of /tcp/av0_0 (artifact of concatenating rtsp://host:port + //tcp/...); same path, not a distinct resource.
Generic 'user=..._channel=1_stream=0.sdp' path (common to many low-cost OEM/Foscam-style firmwares) — not printed in any official Zmodo doc. Cross-brand contamination; excluded.
Axis media.amp path — Axis cross-brand contamination; not a Zmodo path. Excluded.
Axis-style .amp path — cross-brand contamination; excluded.

Generic ONVIF-profile lead (Y-cam/other OEMs) — Zmodo cameras expose ONVIF on some models, but the RTSP resource URL comes from the ONVIF GetStreamUri response, not this fixed path; not in official Zmodo docs. Excluded.
Generic VideoInput CGI path — not in official Zmodo docs; cross-brand. Excluded.

Generic '0/user:pass/main' path (Y-cam style) — not documented by Zmodo; excluded.
Leaked real-credential scan artifact of the '/0/user:pass/main' generic form — not a Zmodo path; excluded.
Generic MJPEG streaming path — not in official Zmodo docs; excluded.
Generic live.sdp path — cross-brand contamination; excluded.
Generic MPEG snapshot/stream path — not documented by Zmodo; excluded.

notes: Older Zmodo / Funlux Wi-Fi IP cameras (ZH-series) use the non-standard RTSP port 10554 (NOT 554) with paths /tcp/av0_0 (main, 720p) and /tcp/av0_1 (sub, VGA), per Zmodo's own Knowledge Base. UDP variants (/udp/av0_0, /udp/av0_1) select UDP transport for the same streams. IMPORTANT SCOPE: this pattern applies only to the older RTSP-capable models; many newer Zmodo cameras (Beam, Greet doorbell, sight/pivot, and other 'smart' lines) run the proprietary Zink cloud protocol and are app/cloud-only with NO RTSP exposed — those cannot be addressed by any fixed URL. Verify per model that RTSP is supported before applying this template.
